integrity: General proof is symbolic via primitive facet normals, unimodular bases and a cited prior support theorem; exact finite checks are reproducible support only. The dated Matsuda--Ohsugi--Shibata preprint and year-dated earlier facet literature are accurately attributed.
scientific_limitations: Only the odd chordless cycle stable-set projective toric family of length at least seven; generic and fixed-point local classes and pairwise intersections; no analytic resolution or higher intersections. Miyazaki 2022 proved the earlier non-Gorenstein support used here; no novelty claimed for it. An unindexed equivalent divisor-class computation may exist.
title: Local class groups and the non-\(\mathbb Q\)-Gorenstein skeleton of odd-cycle stable-set toric varieties
